import sys

def main():
    input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    n = int(input[0])
    b = int(input[1])
    arr = list(map(int, input[2:]))

    if n % 2 == 1:
        print(0)
        return

    map_diff = {}
    evenCount = 0
    oddCount = 0

    for i in range(n):
        if arr[i] % 2 == 0:
            evenCount += 1
        else:
            oddCount += 1
        if evenCount > 0 and oddCount > 0 and evenCount == oddCount and i + 1 < n:
            map_diff[i] = abs(arr[i] - arr[i + 1])

    if not map_diff:
        print(0)
    elif len(map_diff) == 1:
        value = next(iter(map_diff.values()))
        if value <= b:
            print(1)
        else:
            print(0)
    else:
        values = sorted(map_diff.values())
        count = 0
        for val in values:
            if val <= b:
                b -= val
                count += 1
            else:
                break
        print(count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
